description.narrative: The HPMP for Madagascar was approved at the 62nd Meeting of the Executive Committee. The strategic objective of the HPMP is to ensure that the HCFC phase-out obligations under the Montreal Protocol are achieved. The first stage of the HPMP outlines the strategy for Madagascar to reach the HCFC consumption freeze by 2013, 10% reduction by 2015 and 35% reduction by 2020 from baseline values. The HPMP is being implemented in cooperation with UNEP. The main components of the Plan are: 1. Information, Communication and Education on the legislation and regulations which pertain to the protection of the ozone layer; 2. Training of trainers and refrigeration technicians on good servicing practices; 3. Training of customs and enforcement officers; 4. Purchase of equipment and materials for the recovery and storage of refrigerants and the conversion of existing industrial installations to non-HCFC alternatives; refrigerant identifiers; and servicing toolkits; 5. Coordination and overall project implementation and monitoring.
